determinacy.why: Transitivity alone links nothing here: both facts start from France (or run Germany to Poland to Lithuania), so reaching the asked direction needs 'borders' to be symmetric as well. The answer depends on whether the model also applies that axiom.

worlds.summary: The model also applies symmetry, so Spain borders France, which borders Germany; Lithuania borders Poland, which borders Germany.

assumes: 'Borders' is used only in the stated direction (symmetry is not applied).
